profile.headline: Software Engineer/Developer
profile.summary: Experienced Operations Support Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the pharmaceuticals industry. Skilled in Java, HTML, C#, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and XML. Strong information technology professional with a Bachelor of Science (BS) focused in Computer Science from University of Massachusetts Boston.

positions.title: Software Engineer/Developer
positions.description:
- Develop and enhance software functionalities in C#, ASP.Net, MVC, JavaScript, Json, Ajax and Jquery
- Working with real client’s databases through SQL Server and stored procedures.
- Use Visual Studio TFS for source control and tracking changes from DEV to QA and Production environment.
- Diagnose, troubleshoot and resolve logical algorithm, performance issue for the web application and hosting servers using Window Server 2008 R2.
- Coordinate with the operations team to release software changes to Production environment.
- Handle client’s issues, escalations and regression tickets. Provide the quick turnaround solutions to prevent releasing bugs to production environment and meet the client’s satisfaction.
- Other duties from time to time as determined by management.

positions.title: Operations Support Engineer
positions.description:
- In conjunction with the Project Manager, obtain and validate client requirements for assigned clinical trials.	
- Design, build, implementation, and test of client’s clinical trials on the AG Mednet network.
- Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve portal, transport, and network issues with customers.
- Respond promptly to customer problems and questions that come in through email, and telephone.
- Help customers to install, configure and use the AG Mednet network and peripheral systems.
- Proactively work with Software Engineers to provide the team with current information on product problems and resolutions.

positions.title: IT consultant
positions.description:
- Maintain company’s hardware, software and network requirements
- SharePoint administrator, manage users’ account, company’s files and folders
- Interpret and retrieve data from Microsoft Azure database server using Oracle SQL and web GUI
- Communicate, troubleshoot and solve computer issues for offices throughout the nation

company.name: The Counseling and Psychotherapy Center Inc.

positions.title: Team Leader/Research Assistance
positions.description:
- Real-time feedback to monitor a driver’s visual and cognitive distractions
- Design testing environments for our project and manage day-to-day operations
- Communicate and report to project’s mentor for latest update
- Wrote software in C# and interpreted with facial recognition cameras

positions.title: Research Assistance
positions.description:
- Indoor navigation system assists the vision-impaired people navigate through buildings
- Responsible for keeping track on the changing of the indoor environment
- Tracking Wifi-enabled devices and provide up-to-date data for the real-time navigation
- Wrote an application for Android phone to interact with a website in Java

positions.title: Student Mentor
positions.description:
- Member of student group with High Distinction achievements and excellent coursework
- Provide mentorship and support for those having trouble with their IT coursework
- Provided social and peer support to first year student
